mapper.select:
select A.DM_ID ,A.DM_NM ,A.DM_SYS_CD ,(select SYS_NM from TB_SYS_INFO where sys_cd = A.DM_SYS_CD) as DM_SYS_NM ,A.DM_DS_ID ,(select DSN from ndata.TB_DATA_SOURCE where ds_id = A.DM_DS_ID) as DM_DS_NM ,COALESCE(A.MODEL_TYPE, 'PHYSICAL') as MODEL_TYPE ,A.VER ,COALESCE(A.STRUCT_DIAG_YN, 'N') as STRUCT_DIAG_YN ,to_char(A.STRUCT_DIAG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as STRUCT_DIAG_DT_FMT ,COALESCE(SD.STRUCT_DIAG_RATE, -1) as STRUCT_DIAG_RATE ,COALESCE(D.DIAG_STND_RATE, 0) as DIAG_STND_RATE ,D.DIAG_DT_FMT ,B.DM_CLCT_ID ,COALESCE(B.OBJ_CNT,0) as OBJ_CNT ,COALESCE(B.ATTR_CNT,0) as ATTR_CNT ,to_char(to_timestamp(B.CLCT_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as CLCT_DT from TB_DATA_MODEL A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( select S.DM_ID, S.OBJ_CNT, S.ATTR_CNT, T.DM_CLCT_ID, T.CLCT_END_DT as CLCT_DT from TB_DATA_MODEL_STATS S, TB_DATA_MODEL_CLCT T where S.DM_CLCT_ID = T.DM_CLCT_ID and T.CLCT_END_DT = (select max(CLCT_END_DT) from TB_DATA_MODEL_CLCT where DM_ID = S.DM_ID) ) B on A.DM_ID = B.DM_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( select J.DM_ID, CASE WHEN J.TOTAL_CNT > 0 THEN ROUND(((J.TOTAL_CNT - COALESCE(IC.ISSUE_COL_CNT, 0))::decimal / J.TOTAL_CNT) * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END as DIAG_STND_RATE, to_char(to_timestamp(J.END_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as DIAG_DT_FMT from TB_DIAG_JOB J LEFT JOIN ( select DIAG_JOB_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT OBJ_NM || '.' || ATTR_NM) as ISSUE_COL_CNT from TB_DIAG_RESULT group by DIAG_JOB_ID ) IC on IC.DIAG_JOB_ID = J.DIAG_JOB_ID where J.STATUS = 'DONE' and J.END_DT = (select max(END_DT) from TB_DIAG_JOB where DM_ID = J.DM_ID and STATUS = 'DONE') ) D on A.DM_ID = D.DM_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( select h.DATA_MODEL_ID, CASE WHEN (h.TOTAL_TABLES + h.TOTAL_COLUMNS) > 0 THEN ROUND((1.0 - (h.ADDED_TABLES + h.DELETED_TABLES + h.ADDED_COLUMNS + h.DELETED_COLUMNS + h.MODIFIED_COLUMNS)::decimal / (h.TOTAL_TABLES + h.TOTAL_COLUMNS)) * 100, 1) ELSE 100 END as STRUCT_DIAG_RATE from TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY h where h.STATUS = 'DONE' and h.DIAG_DT = (select max(DIAG_DT) from TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY where DATA_MODEL_ID = h.DATA_MODEL_ID and STATUS = 'DONE') ) SD on A.DM_ID = SD.DATA_MODEL_ID where A.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND A.DM_NM ILIKE '%' || #{schNm} || '%'
AND A.DM_SYS_CD in (select SYS_CD from TB_SYS_INFO where SYS_NM ILIKE '%' || #{schSysNm} || '%')
order by A.DM_NM

select A.DM_ID ,A.DM_NM ,A.DM_SYS_CD ,(select SYS_NM from TB_SYS_INFO where sys_cd = A.DM_SYS_CD) as DM_SYS_NM ,A.DM_DS_ID ,(select DSN from ndata.TB_DATA_SOURCE where ds_id = A.DM_DS_ID) as DM_DS_NM ,COALESCE(A.MODEL_TYPE, 'PHYSICAL') as MODEL_TYPE ,A.VER ,B.DM_CLCT_ID ,COALESCE(B.OBJ_CNT,0) as OBJ_CNT ,COALESCE(B.ATTR_CNT,0) as ATTR_CNT ,to_char(to_timestamp(B.CLCT_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as CLCT_DT from TB_DATA_MODEL A INNER JOIN ( select S.DM_ID, S.OBJ_CNT, S.ATTR_CNT, T.DM_CLCT_ID, T.CLCT_END_DT as CLCT_DT from TB_DATA_MODEL_STATS S, TB_DATA_MODEL_CLCT T where S.DM_CLCT_ID = T.DM_CLCT_ID) B on A.DM_ID = B.DM_ID where A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.DM_CLCT_ID = #{clctId}

select T.DM_CLCT_ID as clctId ,M.DM_ID as dataModelId ,M.DM_NM as dataModelNm ,M.DM_SYS_CD as dataModelSysCd ,(select SYS_NM from TB_SYS_INFO where sys_cd = M.DM_SYS_CD) as dataModelSysNm ,M.DM_DS_ID as dataModelDsId ,(select DSN from ndata.TB_DATA_SOURCE where ds_id = M.DM_DS_ID) as dataModelDsNm ,M.VER as dataModelVer ,to_char(to_timestamp(T.CLCT_START_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as clctStartDt ,to_char(to_timestamp(T.CLCT_END_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as clctEndDt ,T.CLCT_CMPTN_YN as clctCmptnYn from TB_DATA_MODEL M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_CLCT T on M.DM_ID = T.DM_ID and CLCT_END_DT = (select max(CLCT_END_DT) from TB_DATA_MODEL_CLCT where DM_ID = M.DM_ID) where M.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND M.DM_ID = #{schId}
AND M.DM_NM ILIKE '%' || #{schNm} || '%'
AND M.DM_SYS_CD in (select SYS_CD from TB_SYS_INFO where SYS_NM ILIKE '%' || #{schSysNm} || '%')
order by T.CLCT_END_DT DESC NULLS LAST

select OBJ_NM as objNm ,OBJ_NM_KR as objNmKr ,OBJ_OWNER as objOwner ,OBJ_DESC as objDesc ,OBJ_COMMENT as objComment ,OBJ_ATTR_CNT as objAttrCnt from TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ where DM_CLCT_ID = #{clctId} order by OBJ_NM

select COALESCE(A.OBJ_OWNER, '') as OBJ_OWNER ,A.OBJ_NM ,(select OBJ_NM_KR from TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ where DM_CLCT_ID = A.DM_CLCT_ID and OBJ_NM = A.OBJ_NM) as OBJ_NM_KR ,A.ATTR_NM ,A.ATTR_NM_KR ,A.ATTR_COMMENT ,A.DATA_TYPE ,A.DATA_LEN ,A.DATA_DECIMAL_LEN ,A.TERMS_STND_YN ,A.DOMAIN_STND_YN ,A.WORD_LST ,A.WORD_STND_LST ,A.NULLABLE_YN ,A.PK_YN ,A.FK_YN ,A.DEFAULT_VAL ,A.ATTR_ORD from TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A where A.DM_CLCT_ID = #{clctId} order by A.OBJ_NM, A.ATTR_ORD

SELECT O.OBJ_OWNER AS "owner", A.OBJ_NM AS "tableNm", A.ATTR_NM AS "columnNm", A.DATA_TYPE AS "dataType", A.DATA_LEN AS "dataLen", A.NULLABLE_YN AS "nullableYn" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A INNER JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O ON A.DM_CLCT_ID = O.DM_CLCT_ID AND A.OBJ_NM = O.OBJ_NM WHERE A.DM_CLCT_ID = #{clctId} ORDER BY O.OBJ_OWNER, A.OBJ_NM, A.ATTR_NM
mapper.delete:
UPDATE TB_DATA_MODEL SET USE_YN = 'N' WHERE DM_ID IN
#{item.dataModelId}
mapper.select: SELECT DM_ID as dataModelId ,SCHEMA_NM as schemaNm ,USE_YN as useYn FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_SCHEMA WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} ORDER BY SCHEMA_NM

SELECT OBJ_OWNER AS "objOwner", TABLE_NM AS "tableNm", INDEX_NM AS "indexNm", INDEX_TYPE AS "indexType", UNIQUENESS AS "uniqueness", COLUMN_NM AS "columnNm", COLUMN_POS AS "columnPos", SORT_ORDER AS "sortOrder", TABLESPACE_NM AS "tablespaceNm" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_INDEX WHERE DM_CLCT_ID = #{clctId} ORDER BY OBJ_OWNER, TABLE_NM, INDEX_NM, COLUMN_POS

SELECT OBJ_OWNER AS "objOwner", TABLE_NM AS "tableNm", CONSTRAINT_NM AS "constraintNm", CONSTRAINT_TYPE AS "constraintType", COLUMN_NM AS "columnNm", COLUMN_POS AS "columnPos", REF_OWNER AS "refOwner", REF_TABLE_NM AS "refTableNm", REF_COLUMN_NM AS "refColumnNm", DELETE_RULE AS "deleteRule", STATUS AS "status", SEARCH_CONDITION AS "searchCondition" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CONSTRAINT WHERE DM_CLCT_ID = #{clctId} ORDER BY OBJ_OWNER, TABLE_NM, CONSTRAINT_NM, COLUMN_POS
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DATA_MODEL_STATS ( DM_CLCT_ID ,DM_ID ,OBJ_CNT ,ATTR_CNT ,TERMS_STND_RATE ,DOMAIN_STND_RATE ,WORD_STND_RATE ) SELECT A.DM_CLCT_ID ,A.DM_ID ,COUNT(A.OBJ_NM) ,SUM(A.OBJ_ATTR_CNT) ,0 ,0 ,0 FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ A WHERE A.DM_CLCT_ID = #{clctId} AND A.DM_ID = #{dataModelId} GROUP BY A.DM_CLCT_ID, A.DM_ID
mapper.select: SELECT DM_CLCT_ID FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CLCT WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} ORDER BY CLCT_END_DT DESC NULLS LAST, CLCT_START_DT DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ WHERE DM_CLCT_ID = #{clctId} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR WHERE DM_CLCT_ID = #{clctId} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND ATTR_NM = #{attrNm}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR WHERE DM_CLCT_ID = #{clctId} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm}
DELETE FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ WHERE DM_CLCT_ID = #{clctId} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm}
DELETE FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR WHERE DM_CLCT_ID = #{clctId} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND ATTR_NM = #{attrNm}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ATTR_ORD), 0) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR WHERE DM_CLCT_ID = #{clctId} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm}

SELECT
'SELECT USERNAME AS schemaNm FROM ALL_USERS WHERE USERNAME IN (SELECT DISTINCT OWNER FROM ALL_TABLES) ORDER BY USERNAME'
'SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS schemaNm FROM information_schema.SCHEMATA WHERE SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN (''information_schema'',''mysql'',''performance_schema'',''sys'') ORDER BY SCHEMA_NAME'
'SELECT DISTINCT OWNER_NAME AS schemaNm FROM DB_CLASS WHERE is_system_class = ''NO'' AND CLASS_TYPE = ''CLASS'' ORDER BY OWNER_NAME'
'SELECT name AS schemaNm FROM sys.schemas ORDER BY name'
'SELECT schema_name AS schemaNm FROM information_schema.schemata ORDER BY schema_name'
AS sql
